common.serverUnavailable: The server is not reachable. Try again in a moment.

setup.title: Set up Bursar
setup.intro: Create the owner account. The setup code is in the file named setup-code inside the server's data directory.
setup.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
setup.startFailed: Setup could not start. Check the setup code and try again.
setup.scanHelp: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.confirmFailed: The code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
setup.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
setup.qrFailed: The QR code could not be drawn. Add the account in your authenticator app with the manual entry key below.

login.title: Sign in
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
login.intro: Enter your password and the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired, sign in again.

privacy.onDetail: Amounts and IBAN digits are hidden in this browser. Press {{shortcut}} to show them.
privacy.offDetail: Amounts and IBAN digits are visible again. Press {{shortcut}} to hide them.

copy.ibanDetail: The full IBAN is on your clipboard.
copy.failedDetail: Your browser blocked access to the clipboard.

summary.attention_one: {{count}} thing needs your attention. Most urgent:
summary.attention_other: {{count}} things need your attention. Most urgent:
summary.allGood: All good: every account was updated today.
summary.calm: Nothing needs your attention. The oldest update was {{when}}.
summary.calmNever: Nothing needs your attention, but some accounts have not synced yet.

kpi.label: Key figures
kpi.mixedCurrencies: Balances are shown per currency: Bursar does not convert between currencies.

cashflow.title: Cash flow, last 30 days
cashflow.hint: Select a day to see its figures.
cashflow.error: The cash flow in {{currency}} could not be loaded.
cashflow.empty: No transactions in {{currency}} in the last 30 days.

empty.title: No bank connected yet
empty.description: Bursar reads the balances and transactions of your bank accounts and shows where your money goes. It only reads: it cannot make payments or move money.

error.title: The overview could not be loaded
error.description: The server did not answer. Nothing was lost: try again in a moment.

home.title: Home
home.description: Overview of balances, cash flow and alerts

account.title: Account
account.description: Balance, cash flow and sync history of an account

connect.title: Connect a bank
connect.description: Link a bank account with read-only access

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Every inflow and outflow across your accounts

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Timeline of runs, messages and audit events

palette.title: Search Bursar
palette.emptyHint: Try a name, a bank or the last digits of an IBAN.

popover.title: Notifications
popover.emptyBody: Consent reminders and sync problems appear here.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This page stopped working. Reload it, or go back to Home.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not match any page in Bursar.

cashflow.srBalance: Balance at the end of the period: {{balance}}.

live.syncNoNew: {{account}} is up to date: no new transactions.
live.rateLimitedDetail: {{account}}: the bank limits how often Bursar can read it. Next attempt: {{time}}.
live.rateLimitedNoTime: {{account}}: the bank limits how often Bursar can read it. Try again later.
live.dailyCapDetail: {{account}}: the bank allows only a few background reads a day. The next sync runs tomorrow.

syncErrors.generic: The bank did not complete the request. Bursar will try again at the next sync.
syncErrors.EXPIRED_SESSION: The bank consent has expired. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.REVOKED_SESSION: The bank consent was revoked. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.CLOSED_SESSION: The bank closed the consent. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.SESSION_DOES_NOT_EXIST: The bank no longer recognises the consent. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.WRONG_SESSION_STATUS: The bank consent is not active. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST: The bank no longer shows this account.
syncErrors.ASPSP_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: The bank does not allow access to this account right now.
syncErrors.ASPSP_ERROR: The bank answered with an error. Bursar will try again later.
syncErrors.ASPSP_TIMEOUT: The bank did not answer in time. Bursar will try again later.
syncErrors.ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The bank limits how often Bursar can read this account.
syncErrors.PAGINATION_LOOP: The bank returned the same page of transactions twice, so the sync was stopped.
syncErrors.ACCESS_DENIED: The bank refused access to the account data.
syncErrors.PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED: The bank asked for details about the request that were not sent.
syncErrors.PSU_HEADER_INVALID: The bank rejected the request details.
syncErrors.INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA: The bank sent data Bursar cannot read, so the sync was stopped.
syncErrors.banking_not_configured: Enable Banking is not configured on this server.
syncErrors.rate_limited: The bank limits how often Bursar can read this account.
syncErrors.daily_cap: The daily limit for background reads is used up.
syncErrors.connection_inactive: The bank consent is not active. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.account_inactive: The account is disabled or unavailable.
syncErrors.no_provider_uid: The bank did not provide an identifier for this account. Renew the consent.
syncErrors.sync_in_progress: A sync is already running for this account.
syncErrors.nothing_to_sync: There is no active account to sync.

alerts.consentExpiringDetail: Renew it before it ends, or Bursar stops reading this bank.
alerts.consentExpiredDetail: Bursar can no longer read this bank. Renew the consent to resume syncing.
alerts.connectionErrorDetail: The bank ended the consent. Renew it, or disconnect the bank.
alerts.syncFailingDetail: Last successful sync {{when}}; the latest attempt failed.
alerts.syncFailingNeverDetail: It has never synced successfully; the latest attempt failed.
alerts.rateLimitedDetail: The bank limits how often Bursar can read this account.
alerts.backupLocalOnly: Backups are kept on this server only
alerts.backupLocalOnlyDetail: Add an S3-compatible target so that a disk failure does not take the backups with it.
alerts.backupFailingDetail: Check the backup settings and the server log.
